name: dobe_todrink2
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind hugging someone: its one visible arm stays wrapped around them exactly as it is, same shape and length, no new arms or hands appear. Only its head and neck move: it slowly leans its head forward and presses its pursed muzzle flat onto their face like a deep kiss, mouth hidden on the far side, no teeth, no eye visible, goo strands oozing at the muzzle tip. Body and lower body stay still. Smooth single motion
